Free web tier: 5 sourcing requests/day (cap via API not verified).

options.name: AliExpress Open Platform: Dropshipping Developer app
options.unlocks: Full AliExpress catalog (hundreds of millions of listings, not verified number) for search, detail, IL freight and order placement; image search (aliexpress.ds.image.searchV2) = the 'find cheaper' engine.
user_steps: Create an AEOP account at https://openservice.aliexpress.com (Create Account, email verification, accept the Developer Agreement).
Profile: choose developer type Individual (or Corporation after W-decision on osek), upload the documents it asks for.
App Console > Create > 'Dropshipping Developer (Individual/Corporation)' > Apply, paste the Reason text from the doc (internal sourcing tool for our own store).
After approval: Create App (name, callback URL, logo). Callback URL: the store domain (W3) or a Cloudflare Workers URL (W4).
API Permission Group: apply for any inactive DS group.
Set AE_DS_APP_KEY and AE_DS_APP_SECRET in the Claude environment settings (Edit environment > env vars / network secrets). Never paste them in chat.
One-time OAuth with the AliExpress buyer account that will place orders: open the authorize URL the script prints; token handling per doc section 1.2.1.

requirements.website: callback URL required (any https URL you control)

api.rate_limit: Not published in public docs (unverified); traffic control is per app category.
api.gateway: https://api-sg.aliexpress.com/sync (reachable from our container, HTTP 200 on 2026-10-09)

env_vars: AE_DS_REFRESH_TOKEN (only if the token is generated manually)
depends_on: W3 or W4 for the callback URL (optional)
osek only if applying as Corporation
options.verified: yes: categories, steps and method list from openservice.aliexpress.com doc API (docIds 1358-1365, getApiCategoryMixed) 2026-10-09. Approval criteria, rate limits and Israel eligibility: not verified.

options.name: Google Cloud Vision: Web Detection (reverse image)
options.unlocks: For any product photo: pages and visually similar images on the web (Google Image index). Finds the same item on AliExpress/1688/Etsy/brand sites so we can then price it via official APIs.
user_steps: Google Cloud console: create project, enable Cloud Vision API, attach billing (card).
Create an API key restricted to Vision API only.
Set GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY in the environment settings.
options.images: Results are links only; no rights to the found images.
options.verified: yes: price from cloud.google.com/vision/pricing 2026-10-09. Google Lens itself has no official API.

options.name: DSers (AliExpress official partner) + DSers MCP / Open API
options.unlocks: AliExpress (+Alibaba, 1688 per Shopify listing) supplier discovery, product search/detail, freight quotes, cross-platform image search, 'Supplier Optimizer' (same product, cheaper supplier). MCP lets Claude call it directly.
user_steps: Sign up at https://www.dsers.com (free Basic).
MCP needs Advanced ($19.90/mo, 14-day trial) per pricing page.
Add the DSers MCP URL as a custom connector at https://claude.ai/customize/connectors (OAuth sign-in, no keys), then start a new session.
Check whether search/freight work without a connected store; if not, wait for the store decision.
